subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Chloé Zhao won the 2021 Academy Award for Best Director.
• Zhao was born in Beijing, China, and currently works primarily in the United States.
• Many critics have praised Zhao's 2020 film Nomadland for its authenticity.
• Nomadland is a drama film about economic displacement in rural America.
prompt: The student wants to introduce Nomadland to an audience unfamiliar with the film and its director. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Chloé Zhao, who directed Nomadland and later won the Academy Award for Best Director, was born in Beijing, China, and currently works primarily in the United States.
choices.B: Many critics have praised Chloé Zhao's 2020 film Nomadland, a drama about economic displacement in rural America, for its authenticity.
choices.C: Nomadland is a drama film about economic displacement in rural America, directed by Chloé Zhao.
choices.D: A critically acclaimed drama about economic displacement in rural America, Nomadland (2020) was directed by Chloé Zhao, winner of the 2021 Academy Award for Best Director.

explanation: Choice D is correct. It introduces Nomadland as a critically acclaimed drama about economic displacement and notes the director won the 2021 Academy Award.
